Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that contracts that allow contracting authorities to provide or exploit public communications networks or electronic communications services are excluded from Part 2 PCR 2015.

Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracts, where the principal purpose is to permit the contracting authority to provide or exploit public telecommunications networks or electronic communications networks, are excluded from Part 2 PCR.
